name: Surendra Sai
role: Anti-British leader in western Odisha linked to 1857 phase
contribution: Surendra Sai led prolonged resistance to British authority in western Odisha, including during the 1857 phase of the wider uprising.
context: North and central India during the anti-colonial uprising of 1857-1859.
impact: His long resistance connects the 1857 moment with earlier and later regional struggles over sovereignty in western Odisha.
highlight: Surendra Sai was a major anti-British leader in western Odisha whose resistance continued through the 1857 period.
seoTitle: Surendra Sai: Resistance in Western Odisha
seoDescription: Learn about Surendra Sai's prolonged resistance to British rule in western Odisha and its connection to the 1857 phase.
shortAnswer: Surendra Sai was a western Odisha leader who organized long-running resistance to British authority, including during 1857.
